group_notes.5: Death: inspected spread-arm opening, raised-knee fall, seated curl, low corpse, rebound drawing and final horizontal corpse. Two folded legs and weapon overlaps checked; no new fragments/effects added.

group_notes.8: Turn reverse: inspected exact p039,p038,p010 progression after repair, including return to approved idle; both facings retained.

review_limits: Static ordered-frame inspection; no real-time animation playback or user acceptance.
Generated fine details and proportions are interpretations, not pixel-identical source reconstructions; fixed source-coordinate registration is preserved.
10 fps GIF/SpriteFrames preview rate is illustrative; original timing remains unknown.
Final art/motion acceptance and browser/Godot validation belong to parent.
